entries.title: Isaiah 43:1
segments: But now so says the LORD who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel; Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called [you] by your name; you [are] Mine.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:2
segments: When you pass through the waters, I [will be] with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned; nor shall the flame kindle on you.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:3
segments: For I [am] the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I gave Egypt [for] your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for you.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:4
segments: Since you were precious in My sight, you have been honored, and I have loved you; therefore I will give men for you, and people for your life.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:5
segments: Fear not; for I [am] with you. I will bring your seed from the east, and gather you from the west.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:6
segments: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Do not keep back; bring My sons from far and My daughters from the ends of the earth;

entries.title: Isaiah 43:7
segments: everyone who is called by My name; for I have created him for My glory, I have formed him; yea, [I have] made him.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:8
segments: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:9
segments: Let all the nations be brought together, and let the people be gathered; who among them can declare this and make us hear former things? Let them bring out their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, [It is] true.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:10
segments: You [are] My witnesses, says the LORD, and My servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe Me, and understand that I [am] He. Before Me no God was formed, nor shall there be after Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:11
segments: I, I [am] the LORD; and [there is] none to save besides Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:12
segments: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shown, when [there was] no strange [god] among you; therefore you [are] My witnesses, says the LORD, that I [am] God.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:13
segments: Yea, before the day [was], I [am] He; and no one delivers out of My hand; I will work, and who will reverse it?

entries.title: Isaiah 43:14
segments: So says the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all of them [as] fugitives, and the Chaldeans, whose shout [is] in the ships.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:15
segments: I [am] the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:16
segments: So says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea and a path in the mighty waters;

entries.title: Isaiah 43:17
segments: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise; they are put out, they are snuffed out like a wick.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:18
segments: Do not remember the former things, nor consider the things of old.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:19
segments: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall sprout; shall you not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, rivers in the desert.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:20
segments: The beasts of the field shall honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches; because I give waters in the wilderness, rivers in the desert, to give drink to My people, My chosen.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:21
segments: This people [that] I formed for Myself; they shall declare My praise.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:22
segments: But you have not called on Me, O Jacob; but you have been weary of Me, O Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:23
segments: You have not brought Me the lamb of your burnt offerings; nor have you honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not caused you to serve with an offering, nor wearied you with incense.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:24
segments: You have bought Me no sweet cane with silver, nor have you filled Me [with] the fat of your sacrifices; but you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:25
segments: I, I [am] He who blots out your sins for My own sake, and will not remember your sins.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:26
segments: Cause Me to remember; let us enter into judgment; declare yourself, that you may be justified.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:27
segments: Your first father has sinned, and your teachers have sinned against Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:28
segments: And I will defile rulers of the sanctuary, and will give Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
